title: 21刀决22离别23八级剑谱
content_zh:
彭天横，五虎断门刀排行第三的高手，谁也不知道他为什么会做了蓝继仁的贴身护卫。彭天横每天都紧紧握着他的刀，却从来没有看到他的刀出鞘，也许凭他的声势和他的名声，他用不着出刀。但是任何秘密都有解开的一天，而这天也是改变彭天横命运的一天。
经过长途的跋涉，一路穿山越岭、乘舟骑马，大家来到浙江境内。上次雾中一战之后，血影门元气大伤，很久没有动静，萧无恨和杨凡一行人过了几天安静的日子，只需再有三天的路程便可到达杭州。
晚上，大家坐在客栈里喝茶，有人将一封信送到蓝继仁手里。蓝继仁看了信之后笑道：“是福记商号的李老板，知道我到这里了，约我过去一叙，多半是为了我名下的那五十担茶叶的事情。各位，我先过去一下。”
大家见天色已晚，便嘱咐蓝继仁路上小心。蓝继仁道：“无妨，有彭天横随我去，大家放心！况且敌人目标主要是杨凡和他手中的密信，您们倒是要注意小心。我回来之后，明天一早我们再上路，要不了多久我们就可以到杭州了。”
蓝继仁和彭天横走在路上，一路晚风习习，翠柳轻舞，走过一座小桥，夜色中出现一个提着花篮的女子，沿着小路缓缓而来，身形阿娜多姿。走到蓝继仁的跟前，卖花女嫣然一笑道：“这位爷，买花吗，刚摘的鲜花。”
蓝继仁停了下来，看着这美丽的女子，笑道：“花是好花，可惜我不是那些多情的公子，一把年纪了，买了花也无人可送。”
买花女子微红的脸上媚眼一转，道：“瞧您说的，像您这样风度翩翩、稳重潇洒的男人，那里是那些轻浮少年可比的，谁不知道上了年纪的男人才懂风情。”
蓝继仁看着眼前的女子，似乎有点心动，道；“看不出小女子还懂得很多，这花不买还真可惜了！”
卖花女子拿出一只花，娇声说道：“是啊，这位爷，你看这花多嫩多美，人道‘花到摘时只堪摘，莫等花谢空折枝！’我这花啊，只卖给有心人。”她娇滴滴的声音和花香在微风中轻轻飘动，夜色中的佳人使人心神俱迷。
但蓝继仁不等那卖花的女子靠近，摆着手苦笑道：“这花我买不起！”
卖花女脸色轻轻一变，依然微笑道：“爷说笑了吧，瞧你一身的打扮，也不像买不起这花的人！”
蓝继仁道：“这花杀气太重，我买不起！”
话刚说完，卖花女“哼”的一声脸色大变，比雪光还冷，一双丽眼忽然变得杀机重重。
彭天横握紧了刀柄，怒视着卖花女，随时准备出刀。
这时另一边一个瘦削，看似农夫的人挑着柴走来，说道：“先生，花不要，那柴要不要啊，我这可是上好的柴啊！”
蓝继仁笑道：“我们做生意的人，‘财’是越多越好，但阁下的这一担柴太重，我要不起。”
彭天横看见此挑柴之人，竟似呆了，然后脸上露出恐惧的表情，握着刀的手禁不住一阵颤抖，接着连身体也控制不住抖动起来。
蓝继仁看见彭天横此等表情，凝神问道：“是他？”
彭天横答道：“是！”脑海里想起了五年前可怕的一幕。
五年前，彭天横去参加挚友“小温侯”吕超的婚礼，没有想到那一场喜庆的日子却变成了屠杀之夜，不知那里来的神秘杀手将新郎吕超以及全家三十条人全部杀死。那位杀手的样子，彭天横至死不会忘记，瘦削、冷漠，一双野兽似的眼睛带着残酷的杀意，彭天横当时奋力与他力拼二十多招，最后却被他一刀封住了经脉，倒在地上，眼睁睁看着他杀了三十条人命之后扬长而去。走的时候他不忘对彭天横说道：“我叫屈杀，你的刀没有我的刀快！”

从那以后彭天横便失去了自信，变得暴躁、紧张和自卑，谁也无法相劝，以至离家出走，不知何时竟来到蓝继仁的府上做了一名护卫。五年了，多少次夜里彭天横从恶梦中惊醒，挚友全家的死亡总是让他悔恨不已，他觉得是自己的无能害了吕超。他一直在四处寻找屈杀，或血债血偿、或死在刀下，如今屈杀出现了，他全身的血液一阵跳动，只觉口干舌燥，心里暗道：这一天终于来了！
屈杀从柴担中抽出一把砍柴刀，对彭天横说道：“很久不见了，不知道你的朋友在地下过得如何，你要不要去看他？”
彭天横一句话也没有说，这时他反而慢慢平静下来，眼睛直直的瞪着屈杀。
屈杀感到一阵莫名的压力，突然笑道：“你看我是先杀你，还是先杀那位蓝老板？”
彭天横面无表情，手紧握着刀，既不回答问题，也没有任何反应。
屈杀一示意，卖花的女子先发动了攻击。卖花女的武器是一条追魂鞭，本来是藏在花篮之中，此时抖出便如毒蛇一般，缠向蓝继仁。
屈杀在等彭天横出手，只要他一动，屈杀便出刀从背后杀了他。
可是彭天横没有动，脸上有一种奇怪的神情，那不是自己主人被攻击后护卫应有的表情，他似乎在嘲笑那个卖花女。
看见彭天横这个表情，屈杀感觉不妙。果然蓝继仁出手了，他的左手衣袖一挥，便如流云一般卷住卖花女的长鞭，右手击出一掌，便见掌风烈烈，一股暗浪直拍而上，卖花女大惊之下连忙撤鞭急退，连退了五步才勉强站住，幸好蓝继仁没有紧逼，她才稳住身形，理了理被掌风拂乱的头发。
不过是一招之间，卖花女便惨败而退，屈杀冷冷说道：“乾坤袖、般若掌，想不到蓝老板竟是少林高手，我倒走眼了。原来你并不需要彭天横的保护，他跟着你，只怕是你保护他。”
蓝继仁笑笑，不答。彭天横的心紧了一下，谁也无法理解他的痛苦。
屈杀鄙夷的看了看彭天横，道：“像你这样的废物，看来我是高估你了，今天再给你一个机会，让你看看我的刀是怎么杀死这位蓝老板的。”
屈杀又一声令下，卖花女从身上掏出一把短剑，形如匕首，冷脸一横，右手挥鞭，左手使剑，重新攻了上来。蓝继仁不慌不忙，双掌翻飞，抵住卖花女的攻势，明眼一看便知卖花女根本不是他的对手。
但屈杀却看准了机会，飞身而起，呼呼劈出三刀直飞蓝继仁的左面。
这时，彭天横却如闪电般地拔出了他的刀，迎空正对屈杀而上，只听“铛、铛、挡”三声，火星四溅，屈杀的三刀被他挡住。屈杀“咦”的一声，旋即转身向彭天横攻出十刀。这十刀有的直劈，有的斜砍，有的划着十字，有的带着弧度……每一招都充满了杀机，快如疾风。
屈杀的攻势虽快，彭天横的刀也不慢。只听到一阵刀锋和刀锋的交鸣声，屈杀的十刀都被彭天横挡了下来，一番碰撞之后，屈杀的劈柴刀竟被彭天横的宝刀砍出了好几个缺口。屈杀不禁恼羞成怒，骂道：“你既然找死，我就快点送你！”只见他身形急转，刀法忽变，左摇右摆，使出了他最得意的刀法“妖龙三式”。
屈杀这三招一出，彭天横的心便跌倒了谷底，五年前他便是被这三招所败，现在屈杀又使出了这“妖龙三式”，他依然看不清这三招的变化，只觉得刀光如幻影一样，忽东忽西，随时吞没了他。可是彭天横已不允许自己再败，五年来这三招刀法似鬼影一样时时缠绕着他，摧毁了他的自信，要么死去，要么重生，他怒喝一声，声如巨雷。
屈杀听到彭天横的怒喝，刀法竟稍顿了一顿，彭天横见势左手竟急抓屈杀的刀。屈杀残酷一笑，刀锋一转，彭天横的一条左手被他割开，在血光中和自己的身体分离。看来彭天横这次又败得很惨，蓝继仁在另一边已经来不及搭救。可是血光中失去左手的彭天横，连眼都不眨，去势不变，右手猛地一刀，插进屈杀的腹部。
屈杀两眼一突，惊声道：你！喷出一口鲜血倒在地上。他没想到彭天横竟用一只手故意让他上当，然后在他注意力放松之时，使出夺命的一刀。彭天横早已经算到屈杀不会马上杀了他，所以便想出了这苦心的一计。屈杀倒在地上，肠子落出一地，带着悔恨和不信，转动几下眼睛，终于死去。
屈杀终于一死，彭天横跌坐在地上，疼痛使他差点晕了过去。

那边正在激斗的蓝继仁化掌为指，很快地点中卖花女的穴道，跑了过来扶着彭天横。
彭天横虚弱地看着蓝继仁道：“我终于杀了他，我没有丢五虎断门刀的脸！”
蓝继仁热泪几乎涌出，说道：“是的，你终于恢复了自信，战胜了自己，彭老哥知道了一定非常的欣慰！”
彭天横艰难的挤出一丝笑容，道：“谢谢你，蓝大叔！”

content_en:
Peng Tianheng, the third master of the Five Tiger Door-Breaking Swords, no one knows why he became Lan Jiren's personal bodyguard. Peng Tianheng held his sword tightly every day, but never saw his sword coming out of its sheath. Maybe because of his momentum and reputation, he didn't need to draw his sword. But any secret will be solved one day, and this day is also the day that changes Peng Tianheng's destiny.
After a long journey, all the way through mountains and ridges, riding boats and horses, we arrived in Zhejiang. After the last battle in the fog, the Blood Shadow Sect's vitality was severely damaged and there was no movement for a long time. Xiao Wuhen, Yang Fan and his party spent a few days in peace, and only had three more days to travel to Hangzhou.
In the evening, everyone was sitting in the inn drinking tea, and someone sent a letter to Lan Jiren. After reading the letter, Lan Jiren smiled and said: "It's Boss Li from Fuji Trading Company. He knew I was here and asked me to come over to talk. It was probably about the fifty tons of tea in my name. Everyone, I'll go over first."
Seeing that it was getting late, everyone told Lan Jiren to be careful on the road. Lan Jiren said: "It doesn't matter, I have Peng Tianheng coming with me. Don't worry, everyone! Besides, the enemy's main target is Yang Fan and the secret message in his hand, so you should be careful. After I come back, we will hit the road again tomorrow morning. It won't be long before we can reach Hangzhou."
Lan Jiren and Peng Tianheng were walking on the road. The evening breeze was blowing and the green willows were dancing. They walked across a small bridge and a woman carrying a flower basket appeared in the night. She came slowly along the path with a graceful figure. Walking up to Lan Jiren, the flower girl smiled brightly and said, "Sir, would you like to buy some flowers? They are freshly picked flowers."
Lan Jiren stopped, looked at the beautiful woman, and said with a smile: "Flowers are good flowers, but it's a pity that I am not one of those passionate young men. I am old, and I have no one to give the flowers I bought."
The flower buyer's blushing face turned flirtatious and she said, "Look what you said, a man as elegant, steady and unrestrained as you is comparable to those frivolous young men. Who doesn't know that only older men know how to be charming?"
Lan Jiren looked at the woman in front of him, seemed a little moved, and said, "I don't see that this little girl knows a lot, it would be a pity not to buy this flower!"
The flower seller took out a flower and said in a sweet voice: "Yes, sir, look at how tender and beautiful this flower is. Humanity says, 'You can only pick flowers when they are picked, don't wait for the flowers to fade and break the branches!' This flower of mine will only be sold to those who care." Her delicate voice and the fragrance of the flowers floated gently in the breeze, and the beauty in the night made people fascinated.
But Lan Jiren didn't wait for the flower seller to approach, waved his hands and said with a bitter smile: "I can't afford these flowers!"
The flower girl's face changed slightly, but she still smiled and said: "You are kidding me, look at the way you are dressed, you don't look like someone who can't afford these flowers!"
Lan Jiren said: "This flower is too murderous, I can't afford it!"
As soon as she finished speaking, the flower girl let out a "hum" and her expression changed drastically. She was colder than the light of snow, and her beautiful eyes suddenly became full of murderous intent.
Peng Tianheng clenched the handle of the knife and glared at the flower girl, ready to draw the knife at any time.
At this time, a thin man who looked like a farmer came over from the other side carrying firewood and said, "Sir, if you don't want the flowers, do you want the firewood? I have the best firewood!"
Lan Jiren smiled and said: "For us businessmen, the more 'wealth' the better, but your load of firewood is too heavy and I can't afford it."
When Peng Tianheng saw the man carrying firewood, he seemed to be stunned, and then a look of fear appeared on his face. The hand holding the knife couldn't help but tremble, and then his body couldn't help shaking.
Lan Jiren saw Peng Tianheng's expression and asked attentively: "Is it him?"
Peng Tianheng replied: "Yes!" The terrible scene from five years ago came to mind.
Five years ago, Peng Tianheng went to attend the wedding of his best friend "Little Wen Hou" Lu Chao. Unexpectedly, the happy day turned into a night of massacre. A mysterious killer from unknown source killed the groom Lu Chao and all 30 members of his family.. Peng Tianheng would never forget the look of that killer until his death. He was thin, cold, and had a pair of beast-like eyes with cruel killing intent. Peng Tianheng fought hard with him for more than twenty moves, but in the end, he sealed his meridians with a knife and fell to the ground. He watched helplessly as he walked away after killing thirty people. When he left, he did not forget to say to Peng Tianheng: "My name is Qu Sha, your sword is not as fast as mine!"
From then on, Peng Tianheng lost his self-confidence, became irritable, nervous and had low self-esteem. No one could persuade him, so he ran away from home and unexpectedly came to Lan Jiren's house as a guard. In the past five years, Peng Tianheng had woken up from nightmares many times at night. The death of his best friend and his whole family always made him regretful. He felt that it was his own incompetence that had harmed Lu Chao. He has been looking for Qu Sha everywhere, either to pay with blood or to die under the knife. Now Qu Sha appeared, and the blood in his body beat, and he felt his mouth was dry, and he thought to himself: This day has finally come!
Qu Sha took out a woodcutter from the load of firewood and said to Peng Tianheng, "I haven't seen you for a long time. I wonder how your friend is doing underground. Do you want to go see him?"
Peng Tianheng didn't say a word. At this time, he slowly calmed down and stared straight at Qu Sha.
Qu Sha felt a burst of inexplicable pressure and suddenly smiled: "Do you think I should kill you first or that boss Lan first?"
Peng Tianheng had an expressionless face, holding the knife tightly in his hand, neither answering questions nor reacting in any way.
Qu Sha signaled, and the flower seller attacked first. The flower girl's weapon was a soul-chasing whip, which was originally hidden in the flower basket. When it was shaken out, it wrapped around Lan Jiren like a poisonous snake.
Qu Sha was waiting for Peng Tianheng to take action. As soon as he moved, Qu Sha would take out his knife and kill him from behind.
But Peng Tianheng did not move, and there was a strange expression on his face. It was not the expression that a guard should have after his master was attacked. He seemed to be laughing at the flower girl.
Seeing Peng Tianheng's expression, Qu Sha felt bad. Sure enough, Lan Jiren took action. With a wave of his left sleeve, he caught the flower girl's long whip like a flowing cloud. He struck out with his right hand, and saw a strong wind from the palm, and a dark wave hit straight up. The flower girl was shocked and quickly retreated with the whip. She took five steps back before barely standing. Fortunately, Lan Jiren did not press, so she stabilized her body and straightened her hair that was messed up by the wind of the palm.
In just one move, the flower girl was defeated and retreated. Qu Sha said coldly: "Qiankun Sleeve, Prajna Palm. I didn't expect that Boss Lan was actually a Shaolin master. I was blinded. It turns out that you don't need Peng Tianheng's protection. He is following you, and you are the only one who protects him."
Lan Jiren smiled and didn't answer. Peng Tianheng's heart tightened, no one could understand his pain.
Qu Sha looked at Peng Tianheng with disdain and said: "For a waste like you, it seems that I have overestimated you. I will give you another chance today to show you how my knife killed this boss Lan."
Qu Sha gave another order, and the flower girl took out a short sword shaped like a dagger from her body. With a cold face, she waved a whip with her right hand and a sword with her left hand, and attacked again. Lan Jiren took his time and flew his palms to resist the flower girl's attack. He could tell at a glance that the flower girl was no match for him.
But Qu Sha saw the opportunity and flew up, slashing three swords directly to Lan Jiren's left side.
At this time, Peng Tianheng pulled out his sword like lightning, and faced Qu Sha in the air. He only heard three sounds of "dang, clang, block", sparks flew everywhere, and Qu Sha's three swords were blocked by him. Qu Sha said "Hey", then turned around and struck Peng Tianheng with ten swords. Some of these ten swords slashed straight, some slashed diagonally, some made crosses, and some curved... Each move was full of murderous intent, as fast as the wind.
Although Qu Sha's attack was fast, Peng Tianheng's sword was not slow either. Only the sound of blades clashing was heard. All ten of Qu Sha's knives were blocked by Peng Tian. After a collision, Qu Sha's woodcutter was actually blocked by Peng Tian.Tian Heng's sword made several cuts. Qu Sha couldn't help but became angry and cursed: "Since you are looking for death, I will send you away quickly!" He saw his figure turning sharply, his sword skills suddenly changing, swaying left and right, and using his most proud sword technique "Three Demonic Dragon Styles".
As soon as Qu Sha used these three moves, Peng Tianheng's heart fell to the bottom. Five years ago, he was defeated by these three moves. Now Qu Sha used the "Three Demonic Dragon Moves". He still couldn't see clearly the changes of these three moves. He only felt that the light of the sword was like a phantom, flickering east and west, swallowing him up at any time. But Peng Tianheng no longer allowed himself to be defeated again. In the past five years, these three sword skills have always haunted him like ghosts, destroying his self-confidence. He would either die or be reborn. He roared angrily, with a sound like a huge thunder.
When Qu Sha heard Peng Tianheng's angry shouts, his sword skills paused for a moment. Peng Tianheng saw the situation and grabbed Qu Sha's sword with his left hand. Qu Sha smiled cruelly, turned the blade, and Peng Tianheng's left hand was cut open by him, separated from his body in the blood. It seems that Peng Tianheng failed miserably again this time, and Lan Jiren on the other side had no time to save him. But Peng Tianheng, who lost his left hand in the blood, didn't even blink, and kept his castration unchanged. He stabbed Qu Sha's abdomen with his right hand.
Qu Sha's eyes widened and he said in shock: You! He spat out a mouthful of blood and fell to the ground. He didn't expect that Peng Tianheng would deliberately trick him with one hand, and then use a fatal knife when his attention was relaxed. Peng Tianheng had already calculated that Qu Sha would not kill him immediately, so he came up with this painstaking plan. Qu Sha fell to the ground, his intestines falling out. With regret and disbelief, he turned his eyes several times and finally died.
Qu Sha finally died, and Peng Tian fell to the ground. The pain made him almost faint.
Lan Jiren, who was fighting fiercely over there, turned his palm into a finger, quickly hit the flower girl's acupuncture point, and ran over to support Peng Tianheng.
Peng Tianheng looked at Lan Jiren weakly and said, "I finally killed him, and I didn't lose the face of the Five Tigers Cutting the Door Sword!"
Lan Jiren almost burst into tears and said, "Yes, you have finally regained your confidence and defeated yourself. Brother Peng must be very happy to know this!"
Peng Tianheng struggled to squeeze out a smile and said, "Thank you, Uncle Lan!"
